newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended narrowly mixed on Wednesday, as selling emerged ahead of the close due to the yen's rebound against the dollar, traders said.
Activity was lacklustre and trade directionless.
"The upside potential is seen limited as investors have been quick to sell on any price recovery due to a bearish outlook for the Chicago market," one trader said.
Prices ranged from 40 yen per kg lower to 30 yen higher with benchmark July 1998 unchanged at 12,990 yen per tonne.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.43 per bushel at 0812 GMT, against $2.43-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean contract was traded at $7.65 per bushel at 0812 GMT, against $7.68 at Tuesday's close.
